decisions.question: S83 disclosed that it read parts of nidana.runtime's phase plan (its .1 section, Scope lines naming the record, a Restated paragraph, S79's pending section) to match the house format, while hsdd-phase-plan reads sibling node specs but never sibling phase plans. Is the plan reworked?

options.label: Keep the plan, record the slip
options.consequence: No rework; the record shows the isolation rule was broken for formatting, and every producer fact in the plan is checked to come from the contracts.

options.label: Rework S83 in a fresh subagent told not to read sibling plans
options.consequence: About 20 minutes; the same edits are expected, since the changes come from the contracts and S82's line list.

decisions.chosen: Keep the plan, record the slip
decisions.why: The rule exists so a plan does not lean on a sibling's internals. S83's changed lines cite only contracts (navigation-api@v1 G13, bus-api@v2 G18, G34, G42, bus-testing@v2 G14) and its own experiments; the producer phase ids it names are the ones the contracts' Delivery paragraphs state. The format it borrowed (how a Scope names the record, a Restated paragraph) is the run's own convention, not a sibling's design. Later phase-plan prompts will say explicitly that the format examples are in this prompt, not in sibling plans.
